# Fixture sentinel prose

A sentence about how a row whose value never arrived is written. It reaches no
terminator, so the value runs to the end of the line and its first token is the
ledger sentinel — a shape, not a claim about a class.

The sentinel arm wants the value to BE the sentinel, so asking it about the
whole remainder never matches here, and the token path then reports the sentinel
as out of vocabulary. That is the false positive this lint gets switched off
for, and it is the same defect class the prose fixture guards from the other
side.
